items.html: And behold, this male drop, which went out from Hochma to Bina, which is in the throat of Arich, and mixed there with the two female drops, it is for the need of the correction of ZON. And this is the secret of the verse, “And He said, I will be that I will be,” etc., and the matter is as we have written concerning the secret of the intent of the exodus from Egypt on the night of Passover, for then ZA was in the phase of gestation within Ima, and the Blessed Name wished to inform Moses that ZA was now about to be born, which is the matter of the exodus from Egypt, and He informed him of the beginning of the matter, how it was.
